answer: Rate-limited registration chokes sybils at the door: the chain's on-ramp issues each device root one registration ticket per dawn cycle, so fielding ten thousand fake identities demands ten thousand days or ten thousand colluding sponsors. Every ticket binds to a marble-hard identity commitment burned on-chain; when two identities later route payouts through the same inlet of wallets, both are slashed. The cost per extra identity stays fixed, and a farm that consolidates earnings self-destructs the moment it moves money.
